name: aria-search-benchmark
description: A benchmark for search/retrieval quality that evaluates how well systems return relevant results for user queries, likely including ranked result lists and relevance judgments. It is intended to measure ranking quality, relevance, and retrieval effectiveness across queries and document sets. Metrics focus on end-to-end search performance rather than single-answer generation.
reputation: A research-group benchmark used for search system experiments; modest community visibility compared to large public IR benchmarks.
